aboutTitle: An engineer’s eye. A personal approach.
aboutText: I’m Mayur, a civil engineer turned property consultant. I bring a practical eye for space, construction and everyday living to the property conversation, helping you ask better questions and make a more considered choice.

faqs.question: I’m just starting to explore. Can I still enquire?
faqs.answer: Of course. Share what you know so far, even if you’re still deciding on a location or budget. The first conversation helps clarify your priorities.

faqs.question: Can you help with more than buying a property?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can enquire about selling, renting, investing or starting a mortgage conversation. Select your goal in the enquiry form so the conversation starts in the right place.

faqs.question: Are the images on this website available properties?
faqs.answer: The photographs introduce locations and a style of living. They are not advertised property listings. Share your requirements to discuss suitable options and confirm availability.

faqs.question: What happens after I send an enquiry?
faqs.answer: Your details and preferences are saved securely with a reference number for Mayur to review. Your contact information is used to respond to your enquiry. Response timing is not guaranteed.
